title: An impossible diagram
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: a hidden underground chamber full of antique valve radios tangled with new, blinking modern circuitry and green indicator lights. Time and weather: dim interior lit by handheld lamps and emerald glows, cold blue shadows.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking; the masked hero, a lean athletic acrobat in a rain-soaked, storm-grey and signal-orange weatherproof bodysuit with reflective silver safety-tape chevrons across the chest and limbs, a smooth brass-rimmed diving-style mask-helmet with two round amber lantern-glass eye lenses that narrow and widen expressively, a climbing harness, and brass winch gauntlets on both wrists that fire braided orange grapple cables tipped with small folding hooks.
Camera: over Penny's shoulder onto a wall schematic; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: Penny pulls a dusty sheet off the wall, revealing a hand-drawn schematic of drones, the lighthouse lantern and the sea, all wired together; she traces the lines with her finger as the hero leans in.
No dialogue.
Sound: sheet swish, humming circuitry.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly with the same camera move, the same characters (Penny, the masked hero), identical costumes and props, the same setting, lighting and weather.
Action: Penny taps the drawing of the lantern and looks at the hero.
No dialogue.
Sound continues: sheet swish, humming circuitry.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
negative_prompt: text, captions, subtitles, watermark, logo, extra limbs, duplicated characters, sudden wardrobe changes, costume swaps, graphic injury, blood, gore, still image, slideshow, freeze frame, live action humans, 2D flat animation, anime, background music
